title: Support verification after stage finalization
summary: Allow script-owned context updates on finalized stages and make POC self-checks tolerate the working-to-canonical transition.
rationale: A tool cannot process its own canonical stage until finalization, so evidence from that check needs a validated update path rather than a forbidden manual edit.

decisions.summary: Permit finalized updates only to narrative context and validation arrays.
decisions.rationale: Post-finalization evidence is necessary, but branch/head identity, file inventory, ordering, and dependencies must remain controlled by finish and restack commands.

alternatives.approach: Hand-edit the finalized stage JSON after running the canonical self-check.
alternatives.reasonRejected: It bypasses script validation and contradicts the skill's rule that artifact mechanics remain script-owned.

failedAttempts.approach: Assert that the current implementation stage always appears as a working-stage document.
failedAttempts.outcome: The assertions failed immediately after finalization because the same stage correctly moved into the canonical stage list.
failedAttempts.lesson: Self-processing checks must identify a stage across both lifecycle collections instead of pinning temporary representation.

validation.summary: Covers finalized context updates, stage workflow, restacking, repair, and publication validation.
The POC loads the artifact with one finalized stage and one working stage.
After finalization, the POC loaded both canonical stages and no working stage.
